newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Wednesday softer against most hard currencies on the back of import pressure, foreign exchange dealers said.

"I think yesterday one guy must have closed very short because we saw some heavy buying early this morning and the (exchange) rates were pretty volatile until the central bank intervened," one dealer said.
"There's been quite a bit of import pressure for the past two days but we expect things to be quiet tomorrow ahead of the Independence holiday on Friday," he added.
The local unit finished Wednesday's session at 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. dollar, down from Tuesday's 11.2950/3050 and was at 6.5525/5620 from 6.5200/5400 against the mark.
It slipped to 2.5370/5410 from 2.5300/5400 against the rand but was quoted firmer at 18.3450/3650 versus pound sterling from 18.3800/4000.
